The design team produces its handover through the DDP Design OS repo: design tokens, a component contract (atomic tiers, attributes, slots, accessibility), per-component and per-screen specs, and interactive prototypes. Engineering targets React on the PWA Kit framework (SFCC Managed Runtime). Rather than build a pipeline from scratch, this spike hardens the handoff that already exists, based on findings already gathered, so it is repeatable and unambiguous. To be run as a series of working sessions with the squad.

- Agree how design tokens (common.css) map into the PWA Kit theme and how responsive breakpoints translate.
- Agree the traceability approach back to Figma (component contract and naming conventions) so each React component traces to its Figma node and spec.

- Confirm WCAG AA carries through the handoff.

- The workflow document is reviewed with the squad and linked in SFCC-205.
